messages:
alex_cs: Heads-up — Acme reporting strange auth behavior. Embeddings requests succeed but generation and rerank return 403 or silently no-op. Customer repro attached, blocking their release.

katie_eng: Can you paste the curl + response body and the key id they used?

alex_cs: curl snippet from customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer key_ABC123' 
 -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hi"}'
```
Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scopes"} for generation. Embeddings call with same key returns 200. Key id: key_ABC123. Provisioned via our SSO provisioner v2.3.1.

katie_eng: Thanks. Can you call our internal debug endpoint: `GET /v1/internal/keys/key_ABC123` and paste the `scopes` value (raw)?

alex_cs: Pasting raw JSON from debug endpoint:
```
{
  "id": "key_ABC123",
  "created_by": "acme-sso",
  "scopes_raw": "embeddings
rerank inference",
  "provisioner_version": "sso-provisioner-2.3.1"
}
```
Looks like the scopes blob contains a newline between `embeddings` and `rerank`. Customer says their provisioning script sets SCOPES via a heredoc.

devops-bot: provisioning job log (job-7921): payload env
`SCOPES="embeddings
rerank inference"` -> provisioner serialized as-is. Provisioner v2.3.1 still uses naive `shlex.split` fallback which treats newlines oddly when running in a shell context.

ian_sre: Root cause hypothesis: our authz parser expects space-delimited scopes. Newline inside the raw string causes the tokenizer to produce `['embeddings']` and a second token that includes a trailing `rerank`+newline fragment that fails canonical match -> rerank/inference permission not recognized. That explains embeddings (first token) passing and generation/rerank failing.

katie_eng: Agreed. Short mitigation: ask customer to rotate the key after we sanitize scopes on our side, or have them re-provision with SCOPES on a single line. Longer fix: patch provisioner to normalize whitespace (replace `\n`, `\r`, `\t` with spaces, trim, then join) and release v2.3.2.

alex_cs: Customer rotated key as requested. New key `key_DEF456` shows `scopes_raw`: "embeddings rerank inference" and generation now returns 200. Rerank still returning empty results for a few legacy rerank calls (looks like those requests hit an older route).

katie_eng: Can you confirm their requests include `X-Model: reranker-v1` header? Also we pushed a tiny hotfix to provisioner on branch `fix/scope-normalize` (commit 9f4b2c) — will release v2.3.2 in ~30m. Once deployed, new provisioned keys should be normalized automatically.

alex_cs: Confirmed — after rotating to key_DEF456 and adding the header, rerank works end-to-end. Customer asked for ETA on patch so they can stop workaround.

katie_eng: Patch merged and released v2.3.2 (9f4b2c). Ops: rolling deploy to prod now. Please monitor key creation events and any `insufficient_scopes` spikes for next 24h.

triage-bot: Incident created #INC-2026; severity P2, linked to thread. Auto-close if no regressions in 24h. :white_check_mark:

alex_cs: Thanks team — customer unblocked and shipping. I'll follow up if we see any more keys with `\n` in `scopes_raw`.
